text:
Emma (Marketing): Hey team — need to lock the localization plan and speaker slots for the May webinar. Goal: live captions + 3 localized pre-recorded intros (EN/ES/FR). Thoughts on timing across APAC/EMEA/NA rehearsals?

Raj (Growth): +1 on pre-recorded intros. For lead routing we should tag registrants by locale and route to regional SDRs during Q&A.

Leah (Producer): Rehearsal windows: propose 1) APAC-friendly (23:00 UTC) for speaker A, 2) EMEA window (08:00 UTC), 3) NA window (16:00 UTC). Each slot 30m with tech check + mic run.

Mike (Ops): We need fallback for live captions: vendor (rev.ai) vs in-house auto captions. Vendor has 95% accuracy but costs more. In-house cheaper but latency spikes under load. Recommend vendor for live event and in-house for recordings.

Zoe (EMEA Sales): For EMEA panelists we should offer a short brief in local language. Can we prep a 60s localized intro per panelist? Chris can help with scripts.

Chris (Localization): I can draft 3 short scripts and coordinate translations. Suggest: record EN master, then localized voiceover for ES/FR. Also can provide translated slide captions.

Emma (Marketing): Good. For run-of-show, thinking: 0:00–5:00 intro/pre-roll (localized video plays based on locale), 5:00–25:00 core talk, 25:00–40:00 demo + benchmarks, 40:00–55:00 panel Q&A + live polls, 55:00–60:00 close + CTA. Need to map when captions go live and where interpreters hop in.

Leah (Producer): Here's a quick schedule snippet — we'll align to UTC for recordings:
```
16:00 UTC — Host pre-show (10m)
16:10 UTC — Localized intro plays (2m)
16:12 UTC — Keynote (20m)
16:32 UTC — Demo (13m)
16:45 UTC — Panel Q&A (15m)
16:60 UTC — Close (5m)
```

Mike (Ops): Tech notes: set up two caption streams (one vendor, one fallback). Route captions into the webcast player via subtitle tracks. Also create a health check script that pings caption provider every 15s during the event.

Raj (Growth): For inbound routing: add hidden form field for locale and use that to trigger workflow in HubSpot — route high intent (attended + asked Q) to regional SDR within 24h. Can we add a tag like `geography:EMEA`?

Emma (Marketing): Yes. Leah — please confirm we can include the hidden locale field in registration flow. Also Chris, can you have localized intros ready by Apr 28?

Leah (Producer): Will confirm with web team — should be fine. I'll reserve rehearsal slots next week and send calendar invites.

Chris (Localization): Apr 28 works. I'll upload audio files + translated slide captions to the shared folder.

calendar-bot: Event created: 2026-05-12T16:00:00Z — "Webinar: Inference at Scale — Localized Edition" (rehearsal invites to follow)

Emma (Marketing): Action items: Chris (scripts & recordings by Apr 28), Leah (rehearsal invites + registration hidden field), Mike (caption vendor integration + health check script), Raj (HubSpot routing + tagging). We'll reconvene after rehearsals to finalize run-of-show. :thumbsup:
